title: Add yours: post your Mizaj card
caption:
30 days in, and the Deck is filling up. Time to show your card.

Take the free test, screenshot your Mizaj card, and post it to your story with the 'Add yours' sticker. Tag us and tag your opposite. Let's see how many of the 64 cards your friends can collect.

Shy? Just comment your card below.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
tiktok_caption: 64 cards. Which one did you pull? Comment it. #mizajdeck #mizaj #personalitytest #personality
audio_hint: upbeat, celebratory instrumental with a card-flip on the drop
reel_hook: Show me your card. I'll go first.
